1860 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year unless divisible by 400).  
May 20, 1860 + 314 days:  
From May 20 to Dec 31 = 225 days (11 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 from May 21 onward).  
Remaining days = 314 - 225 = 89 days into 1861.  
Jan 31 days + Feb 28 days (1861 not leap) = 59 days, leaving 30 days into March.  
March 30, 1861 = 1861-03-30.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1861-03-30
